rows.title: L4 collective and developmental intelligence family
rows.intended_function: Collective and developmental mechanisms whose joint behavior adds measurable capability beyond individual organs, without becoming a second Kernel, authority path or unverified network-effect claim.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: GREG collective quorum and evolutionary families are implemented; evaluation compares arms; most collective/developmental cortex profiles are reserved/disabled (hive_quorum, stigmergy, swarm_pso, slime_network, immune, ecology_market, evolutionary, program_synthesis, constraint_release, morphogenetic, molecular_micro, mica_field). Bounded n-part composition supplies one working temporary collective form.
rows.substrate: Python/stdlib/scipy for existing families; reserved profiles have no enabled executor.
rows.input_contract: Per-mechanism typed participants, signals, bounds and shared artifact references; real humans/outcomes where claimed.
rows.output_contract: collective_trace or composed typed artifacts; no collective output may erase dissent or create authority.
rows.epistemic_type: prediction/optimization/strategic per mechanism; collective agreement is not external truth.
rows.verifier: Removal tests and constituent-alone comparisons; reserved seed rule; adversarial gaming and correlated-dependency checks.
rows.integration_path: Qualify each mechanism through the one genome, router, evidence and learning architecture; founder attach and measured gain required for reserved families.
rows.routing_eligibility: Existing GREG collective/evolutionary families and bounded composition eligible; reserved cortex families withheld.
rows.real_world_evidence: none — no real swarm/market/ecology outcome or commercial result.
rows.blocker: A17 attach plus evidence; real participants/outcomes absent; collective claims vulnerable to correlation and gaming.
rows.next_build: Strengthen the working collective form via metaconsensus, degeneracy and VOI before enabling additional reserved collectives.
rows.dependency: Real outcomes/participants; founder attach; frozen constituent comparisons.
rows.completion_criterion: Every L4 row meets its own criterion and each enabled collective demonstrates marginal value over constituents with removal tests, gaming analysis and preserved negative results.

rows.title: Ensemble cognition
rows.intended_function: Combine diverse solvers so aggregate decisions outperform constituents without hiding disagreement or correlated errors.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Evaluation arms and cross-geometry comparisons already compare methods; bounded composition selects complementary parts; GREG quorum solver exists. No production ensemble combiner with proven superiority is enabled.
rows.substrate: Existing solver stack and deterministic evaluation.
rows.input_contract: Constituent artifacts, geometry, provenance and combination rule.
rows.output_contract: Combined artifact or CONTESTED/abstention with constituent lineage and shared dependencies.
rows.epistemic_type: Weakest justified constituent epistemic type; ensemble cannot upgrade proof by voting.
rows.verifier: Constituent-alone and leave-one-out comparisons on frozen suites; shared-dependency analysis; N3 real-gain gate for composition.
rows.integration_path: Build combiner as metaconsensus/composition extension on canonical receipts; no separate ensemble router.
rows.routing_eligibility: Evaluation comparison active; production combination limited to current bounded composition and GREG quorum.
rows.real_world_evidence: none — frozen benchmarks are not field outcomes.
rows.blocker: B22 attach/evidence for broader collective; zero real outcomes for learned combination.
rows.next_build: B30 verdict-typed metaconsensus is the next coherent ensemble mechanism; require removal tests before claims of added value.
rows.dependency: L5-METACONSENSUS; frozen comparisons; real outcomes for learned weights.
rows.completion_criterion: An enabled ensemble beats every constituent alone on declared frozen tasks, survives removal/shared-dependency tests, and preserves dissent and provenance.

rows.title: Quorum/threshold cognition
rows.intended_function: Require explicit participant thresholds for collective judgments and refuse when no legitimate quorum exists.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: GREG collective quorum solver with collective_trace; NO_QUORUM abstention class; cortex.collective.hive_quorum reserved/disabled.
rows.input_contract: Votes/judgments with participant provenance, threshold and independence metadata.
rows.output_contract: collective_trace with threshold result or NO_QUORUM; dissent retained.
rows.epistemic_type: prediction/institutional_acceptance depending on participants; never deductive proof by vote.
rows.verifier: Threshold and no-quorum unit tests; duplicate/sybil participant rejection required for real panels.
rows.integration_path: Reuse quorum inside metaconsensus/human interfaces; hive quorum only via reserved attach with real participants.
rows.routing_eligibility: GREG quorum eligible read-only; cortex hive quorum withheld.
rows.blocker: Real independent participants and attach absent; correlated model votes cannot establish legitimacy.
rows.next_build: Use verdict jurisdictions and NO_QUORUM in B30 metaconsensus before any hive activation.
rows.dependency: L5-METACONSENSUS; real participants for human quorum; founder attach.
rows.completion_criterion: Quorum rules are tested now; real collective completion requires distinct participant provenance, sybil resistance, dissent and NO_QUORUM under actual use.

rows.title: Cross-inhibition
rows.intended_function: Let contradictory or higher-priority cognitive signals suppress incompatible candidates without erasing the suppressed evidence.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Hard gates eliminate ineligible routes, critical adversarial findings block recommend, and contradictions/UNSAT inhibit invalid conclusions. Genome profiles contain inhibition-related fields, but no dedicated executable cross-inhibition network exists.
rows.input_contract: Competing candidates, findings, contradictions and explicit priority/jurisdiction rules.
rows.output_contract: Blocked/alternative route records and preserved findings; no silent deletion.
rows.epistemic_type: Deductive/structural inhibition; empirical conflict remains CONTESTED rather than suppressed as false.
rows.verifier: Gate/verifier tests prove inhibition triggers and alternatives why_not remains inspectable.
rows.integration_path: Generalize only inside gates/metaconsensus with explicit rules; never an opaque global suppressor or authority channel.
rows.routing_eligibility: Active as hard gates and verifier blocks; no standalone cross-inhibition organ.
rows.blocker: No demonstrated need for a more complex inhibition network; risk of centralization/Gaming if added prematurely.
rows.next_build: Reuse explicit inhibition rules in metaconsensus; do not add a network without a failing concrete case.
rows.completion_criterion: Every inhibition is explainable, reversible in the record, tested by counterexample, and cannot erase minority evidence or expand authority.

rows.title: Stigmergic coordination
rows.intended_function: Coordinate indirectly through persistent shared artifacts/traces so later work improves from earlier work without centralized message choreography.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Canonical journal, receipts, provenance and competence ledger provide shared artifacts; cortex.collective.stigmergy reserved/disabled and no stigmergic executor or measured coordination gain exists.
rows.substrate: Reserved profile; existing append-only evidence artifacts are the only candidate substrate.
rows.input_contract: Future typed trace writes/reads with provenance, decay and contamination controls; not enabled.
rows.output_contract: Reserved; current shared artifacts are receipts/journal records, not stigmergic coordination claims.
rows.epistemic_type: Prediction/optimization only if a mechanism is compiled; traces are not outcome evidence.
rows.verifier: Future removal test against direct routing and contamination/gaming tests; current reserved seed tests only.
rows.integration_path: If qualified, use canonical journal/receipts rather than a second blackboard; no hidden persistent pheromone store or learning plane.
rows.blocker: A18 founder attach plus evidence; no measured deficit that indirect artifact coordination solves better than existing journal/routing.
rows.next_build: No build; first name a concrete coordination failure and compare against ordinary shared receipts.
rows.dependency: Founder attach; real multi-actor workload/outcomes; canonical evidence store.
rows.completion_criterion: A compiled stigmergic rule demonstrates measurable coordination gain over direct routing, resists contamination/gaming and adds no parallel store or authority.

rows.title: Swarm cognition
rows.intended_function: Distributed local-search/coordination behavior producing useful global solutions without centralizing authority.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: cortex.collective.swarm_pso reserved/disabled; no swarm executor. Existing optimization/evolutionary solvers are centralized bounded algorithms, not evidence of swarm cognition.
rows.substrate: Reserved profile; future implementation must be local/open and bounded.
rows.input_contract: Not enabled; future agents, local neighborhood, objective, bounds and seed.
rows.output_contract: Reserved collective_trace candidate with diversity and convergence metrics.
rows.verifier: Future comparison against CP-SAT/LP/evolutionary baselines, diversity/removal tests and adversarial gaming.
rows.integration_path: Qualify only where swarm adds value over existing optimizers; use canonical optimization contracts and no independent agent authority.
rows.blocker: A19 attach plus evidence; existing certified optimizers are strong counter-position and no failing use case is documented.
rows.next_build: No build; require a concrete problem where certified optimizers fail and a bounded swarm experiment can falsify value.
rows.dependency: Real deficit; founder attach; frozen optimizer comparison.
rows.completion_criterion: Swarm demonstrates repeatable marginal value over canonical optimizers on a declared problem class, with bounded cost and no authority effects.

rows.title: Slime-mold/network-formation cognition
rows.intended_function: Grow/prune computational networks through local reinforcement to solve routing or allocation problems adaptively.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: cortex.collective.slime_network reserved/disabled; canonical graph/search organ solves shortest path/max flow with certified answers. No slime-network formation executor or comparative evidence.
rows.substrate: Reserved profile; networkx is available for graph substrate but is not a slime implementation.
rows.input_contract: Not enabled; future graph, local update rule, reinforcement/decay and bounds.
rows.output_contract: Reserved network-formation trace with explicit approximation status.
rows.epistemic_type: optimization/prediction; biological inspiration is not a correctness proof.
rows.verifier: Future comparison with certified graph algorithms, approximation bounds, pruning stability and adversarial topologies.
rows.integration_path: Only as an alternative graph mechanism behind reserved gate; never replace certified answers with unverified analog metaphor.
rows.blocker: A20 attach plus evidence; certified graph solvers already cover the obvious use cases.
rows.next_build: No build; revisit only for dynamic networks where static certified algorithms demonstrably fail.
rows.dependency: Real dynamic-network deficit; founder attach; graph baseline comparisons.
rows.completion_criterion: A compiled network-formation algorithm beats certified graph baselines on a declared dynamic task or provides a measured advantage that justifies its approximation and cost.

rows.title: Immune cognition
rows.intended_function: Detect, classify, contain, remember, recover and adapt to harmful or malformed cognitive inputs while preserving due process and false-positive evidence.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Adversarial verifier, contract validation, reserved/withheld registry states, dependency refusal and import boundaries provide containment primitives; institutional pattern/protection work exists outside cortex. cortex.collective.immune reserved; no adaptive immune memory loop enabled.
rows.substrate: Deterministic Python validation/registry/verifier; no separate immune service.
rows.input_contract: Artifacts, signatures/findings, registry state and explicit quarantine rules.
rows.output_contract: Findings, refusal/withheld states and preserved incident evidence; no autonomous retaliatory action.
rows.epistemic_type: pattern/deductive detection; classification errors remain possible and reviewable.
rows.verifier: Mutation and malformed-input tests, import-boundary test, false-positive/appeal cases required for any expansion.
rows.integration_path: Extend canonical verification/registry/protection ownership; adaptive memory must use existing evidence architecture and founder attach.
rows.routing_eligibility: Containment primitives active; adaptive immune cortex family withheld.
rows.real_world_evidence: Preserved failed verifier/mutation evidence is real defensive engineering evidence; no external incident-response validation.
rows.blocker: A21 attach plus evidence; no real incident/outcome stream for adaptive immune learning.
rows.next_build: Keep deterministic containment; add adversarial cases with new organs rather than building an unmeasured immune system.
rows.dependency: Founder attach; real incidents/outcomes; participant appeal/due process.
rows.completion_criterion: Detect-contain-recover behavior is exercised under real or faithfully replayed incidents with measured false positives, recovery, appeals and no autonomous external retaliation.

rows.title: Ecological cognition
rows.intended_function: Maintain a diverse cognitive ecology where niches, competition, dependency and regeneration improve system capability without monoculture or collapse.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Genome/registry holds diverse replaceable profiles; verifier records shared dependencies (correlated-dependency visibility already built); cognitive degeneracy supplies two formal engines. cortex.collective.ecology_market reserved; no ecological population dynamics or measured niche regulation.
rows.substrate: Existing registry/receipts/solver stack; reserved ecology profile has no executor.
rows.input_contract: Current capability manifests, dependencies, measured usage/outcomes (the latter absent).
rows.output_contract: Current registry/dependency findings; future ecological trace would require real population metrics.
rows.epistemic_type: structural/deductive for dependency mapping; ecological predictions would be estimate/prediction.
rows.verifier: Registry tests and shared-dependency findings; future removal and monoculture stress tests.
rows.integration_path: Use one catalog/registry and outcome memory; no separate ecological population store or self-replicating agents.
rows.routing_eligibility: Diversity/dependency information available to routing; ecological regulator withheld.
rows.real_world_evidence: none — zero outcomes means no observed ecology.
rows.blocker: A22 real outcomes and/or founder attach; ecological claims cannot be inferred from a static registry.
rows.next_build: Strengthen degeneracy and removal tests; defer dynamic ecology until real usage/outcome data exists.
rows.dependency: Real outcome/usage records; founder attach; L5-COGNITIVE-DEGENERACY.
rows.completion_criterion: Measured ecological interventions improve resilience/capability under removal and monoculture stress without harming participants or creating self-replicating authority.

rows.title: Market cognition
rows.intended_function: Allocate cognitive resources through explicit prices/bids/budgets where market mechanisms outperform deterministic allocation without gaming or extraction.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Deterministic budget/latency profiles, hard solver budget and receipts measure expenditure; cheapest-sufficient routing remains queued. cortex.collective.ecology_market reserved; no internal market, currency or real outcome-priced allocation.
rows.substrate: Reserved profile; current deterministic accounting uses no money and no market vendor.
rows.input_contract: Future bids, budgets, participant incentives and anti-gaming rules; not enabled.
rows.output_contract: Current cost/budget receipt fields; no settlement or market price artifact.
rows.epistemic_type: strategic/optimization for any future market; current budgets are deductive constraints.
rows.verifier: Current aggregate budget tests; future market requires gaming, collusion, wealth-concentration and deterministic-baseline comparisons.
rows.integration_path: First implement deterministic cheapest-sufficient tie-breaking; a market only if that demonstrably fails and founder attaches the reserved family. No real currency or financial authority.
rows.routing_eligibility: Deterministic budgets active; market allocation withheld.
rows.real_world_evidence: none — no real market transactions or outcomes.
rows.blocker: A23 real outcomes and founder attach; no evidence a market beats deterministic allocation; severe gaming/centralization risks.
rows.next_build: B32/B64 cost-aware routing at L5-COGNITIVE-ROUTING; do not build a market prematurely.
rows.dependency: Real outcomes/costs; founder attach; anti-gaming evaluation.
rows.completion_criterion: Any future market must beat deterministic allocation on real measured cost/quality, resist collusion/gaming, preserve participant welfare and create no financial authority.

rows.title: Evolutionary cognition
rows.intended_function: Generate/select variation in cognitive candidates with measured fitness, retained negative lineage and no uncontrolled self-modification.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: GREG evolutionary evolve_vector solver (scipy) with collective_trace; cortex.developmental.evolutionary reserved/disabled. No evolving organ population, autonomous code variation or outcome fitness stream.
rows.substrate: scipy/numpy for vector evolution; reserved developmental profile for broader evolution.
rows.input_contract: Vector/objective/bounds/seed now; future candidate specifications require explicit fitness and forbidden mutations.
rows.output_contract: collective_trace with candidate/result and fitness; no automatic registration or authority change.
rows.epistemic_type: optimization; fitness on a proxy is not real-world capability.
rows.verifier: Known-objective tests; future holdout fitness, Goodhart/adversarial tests and preserved failed lineages.
rows.integration_path: Evolution of organs only through Capability Genesis N4, sandbox, independent verification and founder attach; retain rejected candidates.
rows.routing_eligibility: GREG evolutionary eligible read-only; cortex developmental evolutionary withheld.
rows.real_world_evidence: none — no evolved candidate has produced external outcomes.
rows.blocker: A24/B23/B57 evidence and founder/reality gates; zero real outcomes for fitness; authority may not self-evolve.
rows.next_build: No autonomous evolution; use existing optimizer only where it is the right bounded solver.
rows.dependency: Real fitness outcomes; N4/Capability Genesis; founder attach; invariant authority boundary.
rows.completion_criterion: An evolved candidate beats baseline on held-out real measures, preserves negative lineage, cannot mutate authority, and is accepted only through authorized registration.

rows.title: Constraint-release discovery
rows.intended_function: Discover useful new behavior by systematically relaxing non-constitutional constraints while preserving hard safety/authority invariants and measuring the result.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: cortex.developmental.constraint_release reserved/disabled; gates distinguish hard constraints and reserved profiles, but no experiment engine relaxes constraints or compares released vs baseline cognition.
rows.input_contract: Future named relaxable constraint, invariant set, experiment bounds, metric and rollback; not enabled.
rows.output_contract: Reserved experiment trace with released constraint, result and REJECT/retain proposal; constitutional constraints never relaxable.
rows.epistemic_type: sandbox-execution/estimate evidence; no external validity until real trial.
rows.verifier: Invariant tests, adversarial escape tests, baseline comparison and mandatory rollback.
rows.integration_path: Only as reversible sandbox experiment through existing authority; never relax consequence, human authority, evidence honesty or shutdown constraints.
rows.blocker: A28/B25/B58 evidence and founder/reality gates; no measured demand and high irreversibility risk if implemented carelessly.
rows.next_build: No build; any proposal must enumerate non-relaxable invariants and a kill criterion first.
rows.dependency: Founder authorization; sandbox; real evaluation; invariant contract.
rows.completion_criterion: A reversible experiment releases only an explicitly non-constitutional constraint, demonstrates real measured gain, preserves all invariants and rolls back cleanly; otherwise remain blocked.

rows.title: Temporary cognitive tissues
rows.directive_ref: L4 temporary cognitive tissues; review B55/N3
rows.intended_function: Form problem-specific bounded combinations that dissolve after use, adding capability without permanent complexity or a new persistent authority structure.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: cortex-route-policy/0.4.0 bounded n-part composition (MAX_COMPOSITION=4), hard part eligibility, cap_dropped honesty, aggregate solver-budget refusal and per-part typed artifacts/receipt. Compositions are created per problem, not persistent tissues with private memory.
rows.substrate: Existing deterministic router and enabled organs; no new persistent substrate.
rows.input_contract: ProblemGeometry plus bounded required parts and aggregate resource_limits.
rows.output_contract: One composed typed artifact/receipt with part lineage, alternatives and cap/budget refusals.
rows.epistemic_type: No stronger than justified by part composition and verification; formal and empirical validity separate.
rows.verifier: Three-part composition, cap honesty, zero-formed-execution budget refusal, freeze non-contamination and fresh-clone replication; N3 promotion requires beating every constituent alone on frozen composition benchmarks with real gains.
rows.integration_path: Extend the one router for metaconsensus/VOI; do not add persistent tissue memory or a second composition engine.
rows.routing_eligibility: Enabled only for eligible required parts within MAX_COMPOSITION and max_solver_calls; otherwise honest refusal.
rows.real_world_evidence: Fresh-clone replication passed; no external task/customer outcome and N3 promotion not established.
rows.blocker: B55/N3 requires a combination to beat every constituent alone on frozen benchmarks with real gains; current implementation alone does not prove that.
rows.next_build: Run only legitimate frozen composition comparisons when suites/arms support them; build metaconsensus for verdict composition; do not claim N3 promotion from unit tests.
rows.dependency: Frozen composition benchmarks; real gains; L5-METACONSENSUS; N1 remains a separate local evaluation gate.
rows.completion_criterion: At least one bounded composition satisfies N3 against every constituent alone with preserved negative comparisons, remains bounded/revocable and shows no hidden persistent authority or memory.

rows.title: Shared cognitive workspaces / global workspace
rows.directive_ref: L4 shared cognitive workspaces; review A26 neural-ensemble/global-workspace reconciliation
rows.intended_function: Share bounded problem-relevant state among organs so distributed cognition can cooperate without becoming a second Kernel, global authority bus or persistent opaque self.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Canonical receipts, ProblemGeometry, journal and provenance are shared explicit artifacts; cortex.meta.global_workspace reserved/disabled. The directive's neural-ensemble and global-workspace terminology is reconciled here as related workspace/broadcast concepts, but no executable neural ensemble exists.
rows.substrate: Reserved profile; existing canonical evidence artifacts only.
rows.input_contract: Future bounded workspace schema, writers/readers, TTL, access and provenance; not enabled.
rows.output_contract: Reserved broadcast/workspace trace; current shared state remains explicit receipts/journal records.
rows.epistemic_type: Workspace content inherits source epistemic type; broadcast does not increase truth or authority.
rows.verifier: Future access/contamination/rollback tests and architectural test proving no second authority/routing path.
rows.integration_path: Explicit founder decision required (A26 named failure: second Kernel or authority path). Prefer extending existing artifacts over a new global blackboard.
rows.routing_eligibility: Withheld (reserved); existing artifacts shared read-only through canonical paths.
rows.blocker: A26 explicit founder decision plus attach/evidence; centralization and dependence on one repository/global bus are named risks.
rows.next_build: No activation; record a concrete failure of explicit artifacts before proposing a workspace, then request founder decision if still needed.
rows.dependency: Founder decision; canonical Kernel boundary; contamination and rollback design.
rows.completion_criterion: If ever authorized, bounded workspace improves a measured cooperative task, has TTL/access/provenance/rollback, and architectural tests prove it is neither a second Kernel nor an authority path.

rows.title: Functional morphogenesis
rows.intended_function: Organize and reorganize cognitive structure from problem geometry and perturbation, achieving unscripted functional recovery without self-modifying constitutional authority.
rows.current_canonical_implementation: Geometry-driven routing and bounded composition assemble organization per problem; genome/cell health supports detachment/degradation and formed-function lineage. cortex.developmental.morphogenetic reserved; no demonstrated unscripted recovery or self-reorganizing cognition.
rows.substrate: Deterministic Python router/registry/cells; reserved developmental profile for further mechanisms.
rows.input_contract: ProblemGeometry and available healthy organs now; future perturbation/recovery contract requires explicit invariants.
rows.output_contract: Route/composition or abstention; future reorganization trace must be typed and reversible.
rows.epistemic_type: Structural/deductive organization; recovery claims require sandbox or real perturbation evidence.
rows.verifier: Composition/gate tests now; future perturbation tests must measure functional recovery against a static route and preserve failures.
rows.integration_path: Extend existing routing/cell health and canonical developmental ownership; no autonomous structural mutation, second Kernel or authority morphogenesis.
rows.routing_eligibility: Geometry-driven composition active; morphogenetic profile withheld.
rows.blocker: A27/B26/B59 evidence and founder/reality gates; zero real outcomes and no unscripted recovery demonstration.
rows.next_build: Use B29 richer geometry and B30 metaconsensus to improve current organization; propose a bounded perturbation experiment only after those mechanisms exist.
rows.dependency: Real perturbation/outcome evidence; founder attach; L3-Y and L2 cells; constitutional invariants.
rows.completion_criterion: Under previously unscripted bounded perturbations, the system recovers a declared function better than static routing, with preserved failure cases, reversible organization and no authority/self-goal modification.
